messages:
sara_sales: Quick sync — Prospect 'Cedar Health' needs perf numbers for a mixed workload POC. Primary reqs: conversational chat (seq len ~512) at ~800 qps sustained with 3k qps short bursts, and async embeddings (~200/sec). They want a 2-day POC + a cost estimate before EOW. Also flagged KMS/Crypto in the security questionnaire. Any blockers?

mike_reliability: We can do a 2-day POC. Need clearer qps profile (burst length/frequency) and whether they need CMK for the POC. Also which region?

sara_sales: They'll run in us-west-2. Bursts: ~3k qps for 20–45s, about 8–12 times during peak hour. Sustained 800 qps for 30+ mins. Embeddings are batched, typical payloads (64 per batch) but can send singles. They prefer to test with customer-managed keys for production but ok with vendor keys for POC if we show impact.

alex_sre: Heads up: CMK (HSM-backed) adds ~5–10ms per request depending on call pattern; throughput impact minimal but tail latency shifts. Dedicated/Private routing also adds ~10–20ms compared to a minimal hosted path. We can run both variants for comparison.

nina_proserve: Proposed run plan: 1) smoke + correctness; 2) sustained soak @800 qps for 30m; 3) spike/flood: 3k qps x 30s repeated 10x with 1m recovery intervals; 4) embeddings soak (batch sizes 1/16/64) to measure cost per embedding. Use Poisson arrival for realism and keep seq length mix consistent. I'll share payload distro with sample traces.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy started on redwood-dedicated-42 (canary_id=can-202403).

alex_sre: For initial estimates (rough): chat model gptx-7b quant8 on dedicated pool with batching ~16 -> token p50 ~45ms, p95 ~210ms at sustained 800 qps (with prefix caching on). During 3k qps spikes expect p95 up to ~450–700ms depending on burst spillover. Embedding model embed-sim-2: ~280–360ms per batch of 64 on same pool. These are bench numbers assuming GPU kernel optimizations and KV cache effectiveness.

sara_sales: Good. Sales needs cost ballpark: Hosted vs Dedicated for a 30-day POC footprint (including burst allowance). Any roughs?

mike_reliability: Very rough numbers: Hosted (usage-based) for that token profile could be ~$6k–12k/day depending on token churn and streaming overhead. Dedicated reserved (small pool) ~ $25k–40k/mo + burst add-on ~+20% if they need guaranteed spikes. I'll follow up with a precise quote after we size the pool against sample traffic.

nina_proserve: Security notes — Cedar Health requires IP allowlisting, SOC2 attestation, and KMS/CMK for production. For POC we can run hosted with strict retention (30d) and vendor keys but must show CMK latencies in the report. Private deploy is recommended for production. Sales, please upload the signed DPA before we run.

sara_sales: On it — sending DPA and adding the customer to this thread. Can we schedule the run Wednesday 10:00 AM PST? Need a 2-hour reserved window to hit all stages.

alex_sre: Wed 10:00 PST works. I'll reserve the dedicated pool for 2 hours and post the runbook. Plan: smoke (5m), sustained 800qps soak (30m), spike sequence (3k qps x10), embeddings soak (20m). We'll capture p50/p90/p95/p99 tokens and end-to-end latency including KMS.

alex_sre: Runbook commands (wrk2 + lua driver for chat semantics):

```
# smoke 
wrk -t12 -c200 -d2m --latency --script=chat_smoke.lua --timeout 10s 

# sustained soak (poisson)
wrk -t12 -c600 -d30m --latency --script=chat_poisson.lua --timeout 20s --rate 800

# spike flood (burst controller)
for i in {1..10}; do ./burst_controller.sh --rate 3000 --duration 30s; sleep 60; done

# embeddings batch test
wrk -t8 -c256 -d20m --script=embed_batch.lua --batch-size 64 --latency
```

(We'll attach the lua drivers and sample payloads to the run artifact.)

sara_sales: :thumbsup: adding customer contact @maria_corp_cto to coordinate logistics and DPA.

maria_corp_cto: Thanks. Quick Q: for POC is vendor-managed keys acceptable? We need to validate CMK perf before committing.

nina_proserve: Vendor-managed keys are acceptable for the POC, but we'll demo CMK in a follow-up run to show the delta. We'll annotate the report with measured add-on latency and guidance.

result-bot: result-bot: Reserved 4x A100s on pool redwood-dedicated-42 for 2h starting 2024-03-27T17:00:00Z.

sara_sales: Perfect — I'll confirm with Cedar Health and send sample payloads by EOD so you can size precisely. Thanks everyone!
